//: Copy this file to  testsettings.json  in the same folder (the repository root) and fill it in.
testsettings.json is git-ignored: it holds a password and must never be committed.
The test suite and the UAT tool both read it. Each run creates its own throwaway database on
this server and drops it afterwards, so the role needs CREATEDB - the postgres superuser is
the usual choice on a developer machine. Leave Database out: the run picks its own name.
